climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Dutch PDO in the commune of Lochem. It allows still, semi-sparkling, sparkling and liqueur wines, and wines from overripe grapes. Allowed grapes include Solaris, Regent, Cabernet Blanc, Cabertin and Pinotin.
